name: The Family & Youth Institute
mission: TO STRENGTHEN AND EMPOWER INDIVIDUALS, FAMILIES, AND COMMUNITIES THROUGH RESEARCH AND EDUCATION THAT PROMOTE: POSITIVE YOUTH DEVELOPMENT, HEALTHY MARRIAGES, EFFECTIVE PARENTING, AND MENTAL HEALTH WELL-BEING.
theoryOfChange: The Family & Youth Institute (The FYI) explicitly states 'the fyi's theory of change' on their 'Research' page. This page details their 'community-based participatory research approach' as the method through which they strengthen families and uplift communities. Their approach involves partnering with communities to pinpoint priorities, explore research questions, identify wellness needs, and address concerns within faith and cultural contexts. They engage and integrate community voices throughout the research process, incorporate community perspectives on data, identify practical solutions, and share the benefits by distributing practical, accessible, culturally relevant, and faith-based resources. This outlines how their activities lead to positive real-world impact.

rich_narrative.summary: The Family & Youth Institute (FYI) provides mental health research and education tailored for the American Muslim community. Founded in 2006, the organization addresses critical behavioral health needs through positive youth development, marriage support, and parenting resources <cite id="5">via research-based educational efforts</cite>. In FY2024, the organization operated on <cite id="2">a Total Revenue of $497,120</cite>, marking a decline from $850,837 in FY2023. Despite this top-line reduction, the charity directs the vast majority of its budget to community programs, maintaining a <cite id="1">Program expense ratio of 85.5%</cite> and spending just <cite id="1">$0.09 per $1 raised</cite>. The organization is <cite id="6">ZAKAT-ELIGIBLE under the fisabilillah category</cite>, offering a specialized resource for donors seeking faith-tailored mental health advocacy.
